jobs.descriptionHtml:

jobs.title: Creative Producer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We care about doing the work well and about each other. Thank you for reading. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

We welcome applicants from every background and walk of life. You will learn quickly and share what you learn. This is a chance to make a visible difference early on. Most weeks mix shaping ideas with building and reviewing finished work. Details follow below. We keep things simple. We welcome applicants from every background and walk of life. Thank you for reading.

Please apply even if you do not match every point listed here. We grow together. We measure success by the outcomes we deliver for the people we serve. You will help improve the habits the group relies on.

In this role, Our pace is steady and we plan ahead to keep it that way. We read every application with care. We value curiosity and a calm approach to hard problems. We are proud of the product and of how we build it. Your voice matters here.

What you’ll do

  • We value curiosity and a calm approach to hard problems. Our pace is steady and we plan ahead to keep it that way. We grow together

  • We would love to hear from you. Expect a friendly process with quick replies. Details follow below. We grow together

  • Work closely with the Creative Director to plan projects, manage priorities, and keep the team's workload organized

  • Our customers count on us every day so quality is part of the job. We would love to hear from you

  • You will own a clear area of work and see it through from start to finish. We celebrate progress and learn from mistakes as we go

  • Kindness and candour go together here. We celebrate progress and learn from mistakes as we go. Details follow below

  • Expect a friendly process with quick replies. The role offers room to grow as the company grows

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in creative production, project management, or a similar role at a tech company or creative agency or in-house studio

  • We make time to reflect on what went well and what did not. We keep things simple

  • We measure success by the outcomes we deliver for the people we serve. We would love to hear from you

  • You will have the time and support to do your best work. Thank you for reading

  • We read every application with care. Kindness and candour go together here

  • Work remotely, no commuting to the office
